deskyard server list: list the servers you are signed in to

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] server list [--json]

Lists the saved servers with your username and default computer on each; *
marks the default server.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: a table NAME URL USER COMPUTER CREDENTIAL (credential ID only); with
  --json an array of {name,url,username,computer,default}

Examples:
  deskyard server list

Where: on this machine (no server needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
